title: Schiff Warns Of Financial Crisis, Trump Bill May Add $5 Trillion Deficit, Bitcoin Outlook And More: This Week In Economy - BlackRock (NYSE:BLK)
summary: Peter Schiff warns of a financial crisis with inflation rates potentially reaching 16.8%-19.6%, while Tim Draper discusses the future of banking and Bitcoin's role. Larry Fink proposes investing Social Security funds in the market, and Elizabeth Warren criticizes Fed nominee Kevin Warsh for supporting Wall Street interests.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a strongly negative sentiment due to the warning of a financial crisis and inflation, alongside criticism of a Fed nominee and concerns over Social Security investments.
